The grid proof bounds the distribution of log ranks across all 107,460 paid positions. The power-23 proof replaces grid rounding with moment bounds from the 451 tensor factors and charges the full excess paid mass. Power 21 works with the same moment bounds. All 22 contraction coefficients pass starting at height zero. At power 20 the limiting ratio exceeds the directed upper capacity, which excludes every smaller positive integer power for this particular comparison. The carrier loss falls from 904/H to 825/H, with H = 1202400000000000. Even granting the power-23 proof the upper raw crossing and zero cover and rounding loss, the new complete claim clears its ceiling by exactly 14077/300600000000000000. ## Replay and credit

The complete signed consumer tested 0.00387992804545, checked 48 rational calls in both orientations and passed 54 strict and four functional conditions. Controls cover the working power-23 predecessor, the failing power-20 limit, an extra rank-one charge and an insufficient BIT cap. The two signed scientific outputs have SHA-256 `43a9c277ebd2578286cf9d3147db662684bbdad070ac69613622389c5e721073` for the application and `3e206ace6bd05b3c39c0ec153888282ed70537ce7378d58fe741ceac87eb54c0` for the expanded audit. The contribution here applies the moment proof, including completed paid ranks, to the fixed 451-factor word and independently verifies the resulting complete improvement. Ali Romman supplied the all-height criterion and paired caller, Clear1nsight the 451-factor schedule, #7830 pricing and #7973 replay, Jacob Alan Sussman the separated compiler, and DreamingOfClouds the ambient-cap construction. The retained cover authors, Dugongue, Rohan Arun and Cinna Davis supplied fallback, cutoff and recovery components. OpenAI Codex materially assisted the reasoning, implementation and replay.
